_comment: Maps this launcher's systemId to its RetroAchievements numeric console ID and the local ROM hash method. consoleId comes from RA's API_GetConsoleIDs (stable values). hashMethod selects the rcheevos-compatible local hashing used to resolve a game on RA: 'full-md5' (MD5 of the whole file), 'nes' (strip 16-byte iNES header when present), 'snes' (strip 512-byte copier header when present), 'n64' (normalize byte order to big-endian .z64 then MD5). null means RA supports the console for credential propagation but local hashing isn't implemented yet (disc-based / complex formats), so the achievements panel shows a 'not hashable yet' hint. Systems RA doesn't support (3ds, switch, wiiu, ps3) are intentionally absent.
